entries.final_answer: Merge by MEANING across packs, aiming for ~150 files. Each shared anti-pattern lives in ONE home pack: the most foundational pack upstream of the others, preferring one existing depends_on already reaches. Other packs reject it with a pack-qualified rejects edge (<pack>::anti_pattern:<id>). Add depends_on only where needed, never a cycle. Record every merge in the ledger (merged entries, pack of origin, chosen home, why). A merge whose meanings genuinely differ becomes an operator question. Batch the ledger WPs by HOME pack so the home file exists before any dependent pack's rejects edge. (operator ruling 2026-11-25, relayed by the dispatcher session_01E5wJU9WQgVdyyBRFbVHcGL)
